I lost my husband in an accident two years ago and became a single mother, and one day I was summoned to another world with my son. The humans who summoned us called my son a hero and wanted him to fight the resurrected Demon Lord. It’s ridiculous to have my son, who is in still his first year of junior high, fight against such monsters!

Strongly opposing their plan, I was treated as an obstacle and abandoned in a monster’s den. I was powerless and already resigned myself to death, but it was the demons, who were supposed to be enemies of humans, who saved me. As I spent time together with them, my learned to get along with the demons, but the peaceful days did not last long. The only weapons I had were my cooking abilities and my quick wit.

Hyeon-Jung, a physiotherapist, dreams of drawing comics despite her family constantly putting her down. Her boyfriend Seul-Gi is a successful cartoonist, but he can't stand it when he finds himself in a rut while Hyeon-Jung matures and evolves. The two find themselves on the way to splitting up...

Welcome to the world of stand-up!

What's the anatomy of a joke? Should you cross the line between funny and offensive? How do top comedians hone their craft, and how did stand-up start in the first place? Dive into the world of humor with your first ever webtoon guide to stand-up comedy!

(Source: Manta)

Loving yourself is never easy.

There are countless ways to diet. So why are there no ways to quit? An intimate, cheerful tale of growth about a woman who has long struggled with body image issues and eating disorders.

(Source: Manta)

185442.description:
For those fighting discrimination.

Why does systemic discrimination go unnoticed? Who are the people who stand to benefit from hatred? What if remaining neutral ultimately means you're siding with the oppressors? Follow this story about discrimination, equality, and the fight for justice through the eyes of four different characters!

I feel better when I'm on the pole!

Despite the taboo surrounding it, pole dancing is one of the most vigorous physical exercises out there. Though initially self-conscious about her new hobby, our protagonist learns to love her own body and herself through the art of pole dancing. So, then... Shall we dance?

(Source: Manta)

Eo-Nam is unexpectedly invited to join the local women's soccer team. With bad group experiences in the past, she isn't sure if soccer is for her. But after that first kick of the ball and getting to know the other women on the team, Eo-Nam's life begins to change for the better.

Tokio, the king who reigns as the No. 1 host at a popular host club, has been suffering from erectile dysfunction for an unknown reason. To cheer himself up, he calls his servant, a junior host named Ryuusei, and tries having sex. The two of them have better physical compatibility than he imagined, and they start having sex again and again. This "love" is not "fake." This is a realistic love story, with all the awkwardness and anxieties of college students in the Reiwa era.

Terada Yu, a lonely college boy, has a past he'd like to forget. On his way home one winter night, he runs into Fujimiya Hikari, a pretty and popular junior who is shivering in the park, and he lets her stay over at his place for the night. Ever since then, Hikari comes to his house regularly, and they begin to form a warm and peaceful relationship together.

"I love you, Yu." Their eyes meet, as the distance between them close. The voice in his head tells him that this is the "normal" time for a kiss right now. Those feelings would be "fake" if he refuses. And yet — "I'm sorry, Fujimiya. I don't think I'm ready for a 'normal' love affair."

The most clumsy and frustrating love story in the history of the Overlap Bunko Awards begins here.

(Source: OVERLAP, translated)

When I woke up, I found myself in the throne room of a palace with a grimoire titled “Let's Build a Dungeon.” The grimoire told me, in my confusion, that I am now the Demon Lord and my mission: "Conquer the world."

Ryeong is the only one in her exorcist family without powers—she can only see ghosts. One night, during the village festival, she encounters Yuseong, a young man possessed by a mysterious ghost. The ghost asks Ryeong to help uncover his lost memories and break the grudge that binds him to the living world. Desperate to escape her family's cruelty, Ryeong seizes the chance to enroll in Mujang-gak, the elite martial arts school run by Yuseong’s family. As a female student in a male-dominated world, she faces relentless challenges. Can she survive and uncover the truth to free them both?

Burdened with this heavy responsibility, there are girls who have been defeated by the monsters and brought shame to the name of "Magical Girl." They will undergo trial and be judged in the “Tribunal of the Defeated.”

It's up to the rookie magical lawyer Yuri Misaki to defend these defeated magical girls against punishment!

The main character, Sophia, has been reincarnated as a mob character in the popular vampire otome game "Vampire Academy: Sweet ∞ Blood".

In her previous life, she was cheated and betrayed by her boyfriend, and so after being reincarnated, she thought she could live a peaceful life as a mob character, but she ends up being targeted for bullying by Emilia, a bad-tempered orthodox heroine.

However, it is discovered that Sophia's blood has the power to make the four strongest vampires, who rule over the vampire race, fall head over heels for her, and this results in a complete reversal of her status with the heroine Emilia!

She goes from being a nobody to being treated like a princess, and she ends up being enrolled in a school for vampire nobles where she is doted on by good-looking vampires...!

Maria Egi loses her parents while she was still young, but she is supposed to inherit the property from her grandfather when she becomes an adult. But her aunt, Masato Shido steps in and claims to be her guardian, so Maria is forced to live with her and her son, Ichiro, and daughter, Setsuko. On the day Maria's boyfriend Keiichi Ogi, the son of a banker, is coming to propose marriage, Maria stabs her cousin Ichiro when he tries to rape her. She is sent to a juvenile detention center due to the manipulations of Imai, a lawyer who is working for her aunt. It's all a plot by her aunt's family to steal the inheritance that was supposed to belong to Maria according to her grandfather's will. Inside the detention center, Maria is relentlessly bullied, abused, has her food stolen, and is even forced to tattoo a black rose on her left shoulder. 185503.description:
When Kensuke Niikura transferred to a new school in the third grade, he lied about having a girlfriend named Makoto when he introduced himself to his new classmates. For the next four years, even after he entered junior high, Kensuke continued to make up stories about his “imaginary girlfriend." One morning in the second year of junior high, a real girl "Makoto" appears in front of Kensuke…? This is fantastical story about a lying boy caught between reality and deception!

(Source: Shonengahosha, translated)

185504.description:
"I wish I could go out with a cute childhood friend"

It was just a casual remark that Akito made while chatting with friends over lunch. But what he did not know was that Natsumi, one of his friends at lunch, was actually his childhood friend who had moved away when he was little! Ever since that conversation, Natsumi has been trying to come on to Akito, but she is afraid to properly convey her feelings to him because she doesn't want to affect their friendship… This coming-of-age story of a girl who goes from friend-to-lover is about to begin!

(Source: Comic Nova, translated)

185507.description:
Riding in a camper, eating delicious food, and enjoying the spectacular view.

Saori Furuki was a university student in the engineering department and loved making things. After a car accident, she is reborn as Eline, the daughter of a viscount, However, her family treats her coldly, saying that she is incompetent and can only use magic to produce items, and she is exiled from the country. However, Eline's “alchemy magic” is a magic that has unlimited possibilities when combined with the knowledge from her previous life! Determined to live freely from now on, Eline has created a camper for starters. She can move around, live, and make things as she pleases. Together with Aristy, a martial maid who adores Eline, she begins her adventurous journey with a sense of ease. Eating delicious food, admiring the spectacular scenery, and creating useful things. This is a travel story about riding in a camper and enjoying another world with elegance.

(Source: SB Creative, translated)

185510.description:
Ninjas, known for their exceptional physical abilities, mastery of various tools, and expertise in stealth operations. Knights, who pledge loyalty to their lords, excel in advanced swordsmanship, and are skilled in combat. When these two seemingly incompatible entities intersect, a new story begins.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

185511.description:
A man who owes a loan shark money and resorts to desperate measures to pay off his debt. A doctor who disposes of a body to cover up a crime and scrambles to keep his involvement hidden. A woman who is haunted by her past and seeks revenge against the men who have hurt her. Three very different people with their own reasons for committing terrible crimes, but when their paths intersect in a manner unforeseeable, their actions give rise to unimaginable consequences.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

185512.description:
Duk-Bong was desperate to find excitement in his lonely life, chasing rushes of joy until it lead him to steal a company flash drive from his own friend as a prank. Little did Duk-Bong know that this flash drive held the vilest secret of Korea’s richest tycoon. That one little flash drive nearly got Duk-Bong killed...and now that same flash drive is in the hands of a sadistic young streamer. But Duk-Bong doesn’t care! He’s still alive, and there’s much happiness to be found.

(Source: Tapas)

185513.description:
**I’m The Villainess, So I’ll Just Beat Up My Problems!**

After dying in a traffic accident, I wound up in an otome game world. What’s more, I swapped places with a girl named Alexandra. The so-called heroine had already bewitched Alexandra’s fiancé–the second prince–and set her up as the villainess. To make matters worse, I arrived right in the middle of Alexandra’s bogus condemnation. So, what’s a girl to do in a situation like this? Kick her fiancé’s butt and seize the happy ending, of course! But as soon as I did just that, the world collapsed, and I looped back in time to Alexandra’s childhood. Years later, I met the older, incredibly gorgeous first prince. Oh, and he seemed totally into me! Could this be true love?!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

Note: Includes 7 extra chapters.

Rebecca grows up with her big brother Pilar as they pursue their shared dream of becoming a legendary edgerunner like their father. In the megalopolis of Night City, where obsessions with technology, violence, and power run rampant, they struggle, suffer, and cause chaos wherever they go! As they go about their daily lives, a mysterious man appears before them—changing the trajectory of their future. In this manga, a prequel to Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, siblings Rebecca and Pilar’s lives are full of madness as they rush through Night City to prove themselves as edgerunners!

(Source: Dark Horse)

In the church-state of Bellwood, young men of faith are forbidden from having sex with human partners - but the scripture doesn't say anything about elves! The voluptuous elf priestess Kanata is on the case, but will attending to the sexual needs of an entire congregation be more work than she bargained for? Find out!

The young boy “I” becomes swallowed up by the pleasure of drawing and completing a painting, embarking on a long creative journey. Along the way, he must confront “you” who lies in the shadows. What is the true nature of “I,” that weaves between impulse and imagination?

185524.description:
Amoroto, a town where all kinds of entertainment gather. Giro, a member of "Orient," a popular circus in the area, aspires to be a clown, the leading role. In the midst of this, a brilliant newcomer named Rutile appears...!

Kozu Ippei, a high school boy with a scary-looking face but mature (motherly) personality, runs into Yayoi, a cute but devious college girl. Misunderstandings lead to more misunderstandings, as they fall in love.

Suddenly, a demon enters my daily life and covets my soul. I am an ordinary human being, but my 'goodness' is top-notch, so it is worth corrupting. As I become entangled with the demon, I keep getting involved in unbelievable things... The good man's hunt for evil spirits begins.

Hatsune's friends, as well as psychics and psychic researchers, attend the meeting to discuss real-life bizarre occurrences and horror stories, including psychic phenomena, yokai, curses, and black magic.

A spaceship in the shape of a horse-drawn carriage travels across the galaxy.

Riding in the carriage is Ridley, the scientist who built this eccentric spaceship, and her partner Watari, a shy girl.

The two leave Earth, which has become uninhabitable due to environmental pollution, and set off in the carriage. Their goal is to find a safe planet to settle. However, all the planets they visit are very strange! A planet with a god who can bring all things back to life, another planet where the luckiest people are considered the greatest, and a planet with countless libraries… The two girls are sometimes thrown for a loop by these strange worlds…

Even today, they continue to explore the vast galaxy.
"Maybe the next world will be the one to settle on."

(Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)

Aria’s world is thrown into chaos when Crown Prince Julius, the brilliant but insufferable royal she’s sworn to protect as Captain of his Guard, announces her as his future bride. Stunned, Aria confronts him, and Julius offers a way out: if she can defeat him in any competition before the wedding in six months, he’ll cancel the engagement. But with Julius’ unmatched skills, winning won’t be easy. Can Aria outsmart the talented prince and reclaim her life?

(Source: WEBTOON)

185552.description:
The news of the accidental death of Lady Rorona Ryus arrived just one day after her fiancé, the Crown Prince, had called off their engagement. Rorona had been condemned for crimes she didn't commit—falsely accused of tormenting her younger sister—yet she had accepted the charges with startling indifference. They say her body was discovered inside an overturned carriage on a suburban road, her face crushed beyond recognition. Upon hearing of her death, Rorona’s sister rejoiced. "Now the Crown Prince is finally mine," she thought. The Crown Prince merely laughed. "I wish she’d died sooner," he remarked. However, they were blissfully unaware of one thing: Rorona’s death would bring far more than just "good fortune" to their doorstep...

(Source: Alpha Manga)

185553.description:
Countess Rorona Ryus died in an accident. The news came the day after her fiancé, the crown prince, called off their engagement. Rorona was accused of mistreating her sister, a crime she did not commit, but she accepted the blame without rebuttal. She was found dead in an overturned carriage on a suburban street, her face tragically smashed in. When Rorona's sister learned of her death, she was delighted. "The prince is now mine," she said. The prince laughed, "I wish she had died sooner." But they had no idea what Rorona's death would bring.

(Source: Regina Bunko, translated)

Seina Isolde is a socialite with a villainous reputation. She was accused of bullying the crown princess, taking advantage of her role as the crown prince's fiancee. When the scandal broke, their engagement was broken off, and she took her own life. But then, an anonymous letter claims that Seina Isolde was murdered. Aria, the prime minister's daughter, is assigned to investigate. After she interviews the people involved, what emerges is a surprisingly picture of Seina. Seina had been used and exploited by the people around her, and she was forced to hide her true self and act like a villainess instead. Why did she have to die? And who sent the letter? As Aria searches for the truth, things take a dramatic turn…!

(Source: Alphapolis, translated) Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

Takashi, who has been living a reclusive life, wakes up one morning to find himself transported to a dungeon overrun with monsters. 185571.description: Kanomiya Tsukuru has a special ability since childhood. He can see the people's misfortunes manifested in the form of a black mist, and he can even purify them. Kanomiya has spent most of his life keeping his ability a secret, but on his first day of high school, he sees a beautiful girl, Arisu Howl, smothered by the black mist. Smitten with her beauty, and worried for her future, Kanomiya starts stalking Arisu... and an action-packed supernatural school adventure begins!

185572.description:
High schooler Li Huowang can close his eyes and be transported to an uncanny world. Over there, he is a medicine primer who will be made into pills by his "Master" at any given time. Meanwhile, in the real world, Li Huowang is living in a mental hospital, unfit to continue school. The doctor told him that the uncanny world is just his hallucinations. What is real, and what is fake? Li Huowang really does not know.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Abnormal Immortal Record of Spooky Daoist

185573.description:
Our world is actually falling apart, unbeknownst to most. A bizarre apparatus hiding in the depths of Ueno's Shinobazu Pond, a giant snail clinging onto the Eiffel Tower, a demon lord in the form of a beautiful girl... these and countless other cryptic entities—called "Ends"—are driving us closer to the apocalypse. However, some youngsters decided to reject that fate and secretly took up arms.

They are fighting, not to stop the countdown or to eradicate the threats, but only to delay the inevitable. Why would they choose such a thorny path on their own volition? To make the most out of their youth in this godforsaken world! I, a former cartel slave (and ESPer), have had a pretty shit life so far, to be honest. But maybe here I'll be able to lead a fulfilling school life, at least?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

"I really don't know how I should feel when my much younger, very adorable coworker calls me cute."

Andrew O'Connell is charming, smooth-talking servant at a grand Irish estate who prides himself on his ability to woo any woman. When the notoriously reclusive and shy Nora Greenwood arrives at the mansion as a guest, Andrew's friends throw down a challenge. Confident in his charms, Andrew wagers that he can easily seduce the quiet lady. It should have been an easy win, but when he finally gets Nora alone, he discovers that her "timid" reputation is a massive lie. Nora has a hidden side that is bold, demanding, and completely addictive. Andrew thought he was the player, but he’s about to find he’s just the prize.

His classmate Fukuda Ema, whose looks rival even celebrities and models, calls out to him, inviting Ryuu to reconnect with him. The two used to be childhood friends, but now, Ryuu believes they’re in two completely different worlds and rejects him. But Ema, who used to be insecure as well, isn’t willing to let Ryuu fade into the background. He admits to Ryuu that it’s only because of the young man’s kindness that he was able to blossom into who he is today. Can Ema help Ryuu to see his own beauty and get his friend back? Japan, has a piano-playing population of 1.6 million people, one of the largest in the world, of which fewer than 10 are professional pianists who can make a living from concerts. Kanade Tendo, a fifth grader, was the best piano player in Japan. He was not good at all in studies or athletics, but that was okay. He was the best piano player in Japan, and that alone made him the center of attention and silenced criticism, even from the teacher. Then one day, a transfer student named Koharu Sakura arrives. As often happens, she became the target of bullying in class. Kanade, who is assigned to teach her piano by chance, notices a certain talent in her.

A world where people live in fear of magical beasts... Nobles with magical powers are known as "noble sorcerers" and they use their magic to destroy the beasts. Stella, the only daughter of Count Norris, should have died after marrying the violent Ethan Elliott and being locked in his cellar. But when she opened her eyes, she had returned to the day when her engagement was decided. To avoid facing the same future, she ran away. She then met a man named Lucas in the forest.

Although Lucas is the son of Count Bloodrare, he is called incompetent because he is unable to use magic and is rumored to be impotent as well, because he does not physically react to any woman. Lucas cannot rejuvenate his magic on his own, but he recovers a little of it when he touches Stella, something that has never happened before no matter what he tried. In order for Lucas to recover his magical powers and for Stella to be free, the two enter into a year-long contract marriage.

However, each time they come into contact with each other, they start to become attracted to each other, and they finally cross the line. Then, after recovering a great amount of his magical power, Lucas finally awakens his true power...

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

That’s when he comes face-to-face with someone he never expected to meet: Abraham Lincoln.

And that’s not even the most surprising news he drops on Kiego: the six dangerous members of “La Llorona” are here too! Suwa is a transfer student with a straightforward personality, but of course he is much too young and totally out of the question! But he won't give up so easily…?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

185787.description:
Komachi, a working cabaret club hostess, takes on a new fight as a rookie lawmaker!

Serizawa Komachi ran for the Japanese Diet and was elected, thanks to her proposal to set up a daycare center specializing in helping the "nightlife workers." Her background as a "working" cabaret girl and single mother, combined with her fearless character, soon makes her a hot topic in the media, as she garners enthusiastic support, especially from working mothers. Single-parent families, poverty, and a yawning gender gap. Can Komachi overcome the entrenched powers in Japan, a "country of gender inequality"?

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

185788.description:
A high schooler battles for his life using superpowers he buys and sells on a mysterious app!

185790.description:
Ji Seo-Jun is someone who has been by my side for most of my life, from birth all the way through high school. But being good friends with such a handsome guy caused all sorts of trouble for me, Mun Da-Yul, at school. I swore to myself that I wouldn't put up with it anymore. But… after getting drunk one night, I found myself waking up the next morning naked in bed in a strange hotel room, sleeping next to Ji Seo-Jun! Can our friendship of 29 years still be saved?

Urban legends have become reality. The world is now ruled by demons and hunters. Li Xiaohei, a college student whose only wish is to survive, finds his world turned upside down. When he gains a mysterious system that lets him see ten minutes into the future, everything changes. Suddenly, he can predict deadly encounters, control the demons, and navigate the horror game that reality has become. But as Xiaohei grows stronger and the bodies pile up, he starts questioning everything. In a world where trust kills and mercy is weakness, who is the real demon?

(Source: Tappytoon)

185792.description:
Himeko loves the character Kitaoji-kun from the shoujo manga Ice Princess. She dreams of the day when a boy like Kitaoji-kun will call her "princess." Tamako Ichinose, also known as Ouji-chan, is a popular classmate who looks a bit like Kitaoji-kun. One day, Himeko bumps into Ouji-chan during a classroom change and discovers their secret…

When she suddenly loses her job, she decides to enroll in a college in Tokyo for a change of pace, in the name of "self-discovery." What awaits her there is a love affair (?) with a mysterious boy who's barely 18.

Cocco, a rooster who believes himself to be a hen, has a big dream: "I want to lay an egg!"

Ahead of the third season of the anime, this is an Oregairu comic anthology created by a stellar cast of manga artists from Sunday GX! It also features illustrations by guest artists! Don't miss these special "Oregairu" episodes that can only be seen here!

After the long night, terror shall reign! Supernatural monsters descend upon the modern city! Common sense and rules of law are no more! Blood rains down on a peaceful campus, tombs crack open in the cemetery on the outskirts of town, and the slums are haunted by shadowy apparitions… In this dark and desperate world, there is a post office that only emerges at midnight, where a young man dressed in black can navigate these mysterious and terrifying places. The young man in black will become a legend, his stories passed around in secret by word-of-mouth, “He is the Great Lord of the Underworld!”

185815.description:
He Qingyang transmigrates into his favorite game, but he takes over the body of a doomed NPC whose backstory he always skipped over in the game. All he knows that he was harassing the female lead Yu Yiwan, and when she found out, she cut him down with one stroke of her sword. Trying to change his NPC fate, he tries to finish his missions as soon as possible so he could escape. But it turns out his fate is more tied to Yu Yiwan than he realized…

185816.description:
After a lifetime of bloodshed, the Heavenly Demon longs for peace. In his final moments, he uncovers the truth about his power and yearns for a different life. He wakes up in the body of Tae-San Byeok, the frail second son of a powerful merchant family, barely clinging to life. Using his knowledge from his life as the Heavenly Demon, Tae-San must navigate a world of temptation and corruption to survive. As his martial arts reputation grows, new enemies emerge to disrupt his quiet life. Yet, Tae-San is determined to live on his own terms, despite the chaos around him.

(Source: WEBTOON)

185817.description:
Anything and everything—Unhwi Yeon, heir apparent to the Heavenly Demonic Cult, owes his master at least that much. Unable to learn who is backing the cult members who betrayed them both, Unhwi is forced to flee into the body of Unhwi Dang with the help of forbidden magic. Isolated, alone, years into his future, moving from one assassination attempt to another—but capable of cultivating Naegong for the first time in his life. Anything necessary to protect his master is as good as done.

(Source: Tapas)

The island of Gluta, a land of the unknown and strange. Jodie Lukina is a "denkou egaka" (electric illumination painter) in her second year of college. She has an amazing talent for drawing pictures by emitting thoughts from the tip of her brush! In this book, you will find a number of strange and imaginative techniques developed by the geniuses known as “ajils," and the many sympathetic stories surrounding them are depicted with the best Japanese painting skills; Masahiko Dairaku's series of Gluta-tou manga is fully hand-drawn with a fully analog manuscript.

A boy blessed with talenty by the gymnastic gods, but who has never had the opportunity, will get a chance to show the world!! Haneru Kurou, a bully by nature, spends time after school peeking at the girls' gymnastics team practices! He feels guilty, but he can't help himself… and he thought he would always just be a lame peeping-tom…

A scarlet serpent that dwells deep in the abyss, seen in a vivid dream. What is the nature of the “snake” lurking inside Kako, a girl from an orphanage…!?

185845.description:
Nagato Momiji dislikes his fellow actor Akira Shinonome. When they last performed together, Shinonome called Momiji by “Momi-chan,” and that gave people a cutesy image of him that stuck. When he really wanted to present himself as a cool dude! Despite that, he and Shinonome got the chance to co-star in a drama, and they had a get-together to celebrate. Drunkenly, Shinonome's usual kind smile disappears, and his Kansai accent becomes a little slurred… Suddenly, he kisses Momiji and confesses, “I've always had a crush on you...”!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

185868.description:
Haruto's a popular, kind, and reliable policeman. During one of his patrol shifts, he almost gets into an accident, but is luckily saved by a tall, handsome guy named Sakura who catches and carries him off like a princess! Sakura's younger and stronger than Haruto, and he's currently working as a bodyguard for a celebrity. Haruto can't help but be enamored with him, even as another man. When Haruto tries to get close to Sakura, he quietly distances himself from him... It seems Sakura has some kind of trauma when it comes to cops. However, Haruto's cheerful nature eventually gets Sakura to open up. Heart-throbbing events unfold as Haruto starts to discover a side of Sakura that only he gets to see...!

Both of them experience something they haven't in a long time through a mature version of youthful love that's both pure and bittersweet.

(Source: Renta!)

185869.description:
Middle school English teacher Mr. Miyata is bummed at the idea of having to supervise the kendo club from spring, all because he's bad at getting along with sporty types. At first, he also thinks that Mr. Samehara, the affiliated high school's P.E. teacher in charge of coaching the kendo club, will be a meathead, too. But, he begins to feel that there might be something going on behind his fleeting, fake smile. Unable to resist the urge to find out what he's hiding, Mr. Miyata takes a leap of faith and...

(Source: Renta!)

This work is a spin-off comic of the TV anime Mobile Suit Gundam: Witch of Mercury that began broadcasting in October 2022.

Rin finds himself unable to ignore his hopelessly clumsy and awkward college classmate, Arata, and they quickly become friends. Arata is a complete disaster at daily life, and Rin is constantly helping out with his meals and cleanup, as Arata grows increasingly dependent on him. Classes and clubs activities at school bring them even closer. But what will happen when Arata sees through to Rin's "true nature" behind his helpful personality…

Most problems in life can be solved with skilled hands and a little bit of oil. And when the swim team ace, Manami, starts seeing her swim times get worse, she takes the opportunity to try out the local sports massage therapy clinic. Little does she know, however, that she's going to get rubbed up and down and inside and out!

185883.description:
For some reason, Fresia, a plain, glasses-wearing village girl, is getting unwanted attention from humanity's greatest hero, Erwin the Brave! She tries to ask for help from other people, only to receive congratulations instead. When she runs away from the village, she is instantly detected by his “clairvoyance” and forced into a date with him, with world peace at stake. She must fend him off on her own (but her fighting skills are weak), so she starts on a training scheme.

"You can fall for me or you can kill me? It'll be like a contest."
Freedom vs. forced marriage - a yandere doting fantasy!

(Source: cmoa, translated)

185884.description:
Based on the erotic game by frill.

Kei works for a large company and is enjoying life to the fullest. His hobby is giving overnight stays to women who have nowhere to go for complicated reasons, and having physical relations in return. As usual, Kei looks around on an app, and when he meets Sana at the appointed place, where she stands alone, he senses something dangerous about her, as she looks more cute and fragile than he had imagined. Usually, his relationship ends without any hard feelings, but he doesn't go all the way with Sana, and they end up meeting again a few days later...

(Source: Parabook, translated)

Carefree and house-free, Seo-Ha has spent a long time mooching off of guys in trade for some sex and fun. One day, he runs into Jae-Won, a rich and quiet guy who seems to be willing to lend a helping hand with no strings attached…but are we sure that there’s no strings pulling at Seo-Ha at all?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: It Was You From The Beginning

185894.description:
Ba-Da never dreamed of getting into a steamy relationship with a celebrity before. Well, until recently, that is. Now, after meeting famous actor Shim Chae-Yoon and getting an offer from the nation’s heartthrob to teach him how to be in a relationship, Ba-Da has been having some explicit dreams. Except…maybe they’re more than dreams. The line between dream and reality is fading faster by the day…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

185895.description:
The Public Security Police, an elite division composed only of hand-picked investigators. Among them, one man was feared as "the greatest in history" and "the monster": Ikaruga. Then, suddenly, he leaves Public Security behind. What does he start instead? A detective agency. What lies behind the 'monster's' true intentions...?

(Source: emaqi)

title.native: ベアフェイス ～公安を去った男～

185896.description:
Ravi has been on the run ever since she escaped an encounter with a powerful demon hunter. Along the way, she landed herself inside the world of a book…that happens to be a BL novel. Not a single man in this world is straight, and as a succubus, Ravi is quite doomed. But when she finally finds a hot dude interested in her—huh? Wait, is that the demon hunter she’s been running from?! What’s he doing here?!

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: I Ran Away From The Hunter
ハンターから逃れた！~サキュバスの生存奮闘記〜

After Do-Wan is shipped off for military service and Chain is left behind in their apartment, loneliness settles in…and so does the horniness. Just how exactly will Cha-Min cope with the absences of his boyfriend and a regular sex life? A spin-off of the beloved Room to Room!

(Source: Lezhin US)

185899.description:
At the start of the summer monsoon season and after serving nearly six years for a failed murder attempt, Seoha is released and finds refuge at Maison de Menthe, thanks to an old prison acquaintance, Choi Minyeong. But soon, a man unexpectedly enters Seoha’s life—the very neighbor Minyeong warned him about.

"There's a lunatic living next door... He's a creepy perv who's always trying to get me to sleep with him."

Blunt and unapologetic in his desires, the man becomes Seoha’s one escape from a past filled with nightmares—the only thing that makes her feel alive again.

"Why don't we keep hooking up, then?"
"Why?"
"They say people only realize that they're alive when they feel the warmth of another..."
"..."
"Cause I'm trying to keep you alive, pretty girl."
"Fine..."

Little by little, the emptiness in Seoha’s life begins to be filled with Kwon Yiheon. But there's something fishy about this man…

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: แมนชันปรารถนารัก

185902.description:
Ha-Won, known for his good looks and numerous passionate encounters, suddenly finds himself facing an unexpected problem—erectile dysfunction—after receiving harsh criticism during a one-night stand. Shocked and embarrassed, he tries to drown his sorrows at a bar, where he ends up venting his frustrations to the bartender and anyone who'll listen. That’s when Seo-Kjun, who was singing at the bar, steps in to help drunk Ha-Won.

“Hey…can you get up...?”
“No! I can’t get it up!!!”

As Ha-Won desperately pleads for help with his ""technique,"" Seo-Kjun offers to teach him through hands-on practice at a nearby motel. What begins as a night of comfort and guidance leads to an unexpected mix of motives and misunderstandings in this unlikely encounter.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one prologue.

185904.description:
Anzu, a high school girl, lives in a household where her mother has created a "perfectly controlled environment." Defying her mother’s wishes isn’t even an option. She has no smartphone, no allowance, and her only small escape is sneaking off to the listening booths at a CD shop, hidden from her mother’s watchful gaze. One fateful night, at the station’s roundabout, she encounters someone 
unforgettable— A “dangerous guy” with a devilish face but an angel’s touch on the guitar. Feel the chills as you dive into this deeply moving story by a 22-year-old rising star.

185905.description:
Everything Jae-Chan did was driven by his selfish one-sided obsession over his partner esper, Woo-Jin. It's only in his dying moments after a dangerous mission that he regrets getting in the way of Woo-Jin's happiness. So when he's sent six years into the past by an unexpected supernatural event, Jae-Chan decides to use his knowledge of the future and his guide powers to help Woo-Jin from behind the scenes. But the more Jae-Chan tries to distance himself from Woo-Jin, the less the esper will leave him alone! Can Jae-Chan truly give up on Woo-Jin and succeed at his selfless mission?

(Source: Tappytoon)

185906.description:
Woo-Yeon, who is perfect in everyone's eyes, and Jae-Hee, who have been living their lives without any major ups and downs, loving each other. One day, as a bride-to-be preparing for her wedding with Woo-Yeon, Jae-Hee has a dream about the day she first met Woo-Yeon. Since then, Woo-Yeon seems different and memories she had forgotten start to pop up out of nowhere...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

185907.description:
Kim Cheong-ah wants nothing more than to quit her soul-crushing convenience store job, leave her deadbeat boyfriend, and forget her abusive past. But lacking the funds and the courage, she remains stuck living in a tiny one-room apartment. Her dreary reality takes a chaotic turn when a powerful, slick-talking gangster abruptly crashes into her life. He doesn't care about her debts or her past, but he demands her absolute attention. Cheong-ah knows getting involved with the underworld is dangerous, but the more he pulls her in, the harder it is to think about anyone else.

(Source: Lezhin US)

So-Eon takes care of the dog 'Mango' in place of her brother who is overseas on a business trip. She brought him home without much thought... but there are too many things to worry about, such as walks, food, and toilet use. Then one day, while walking, she accidentally loses Mango! Luckily, someone catches Mango and returns it to So-Eon... But this guy... isn't he handsome?

Cha Yoon-Jin, the second generation of a conglomerate, approaches actress Yeon Seo-Hee, who refuses to do supporting roles even if she dies. “Let’s meet. I’ll give you what you want.” An affair with a married man? It’s immoral, but it’s so thrilling! Seo-Hee accepts Yoon-Jin’s sweet offer… Four people for whom morality does not exist: actress Yeon Seo-Hee, Cha Yoon-Jin, the second generation of a conglomerate, Yoon-Jin’s younger brother Chai-Jin, and Yoon-Jin’s wife Min Soo-Mi. Their relationship begins to get complicated.

185913.description:
"I'm gonna live a normal life!"

Cho-Eun, the heir to the powerful underground clan, Hongsal, has entered university. Her only wish? To make lots of friends and enjoy a peaceful, ordinary college life. But who are these four mysterious guys constantly hanging around her?

"Are you my enemy? My ally? Or... do you like me?"

Thrown into a whirlwind of emotions at twenty, can Cho-Eun finally achieve the campus life she's always dreamed of?

(Source: WEBTOON)

185973.description:
Award-winning cartoonist Keum Suk Gendry-Kim demystifies the inscrutable North Korean leader

A woman falls over a thin black line, slicing her in two—half becoming North Korea, the other half becoming South. From the Island of Ganghwa, a seemingly idyllic rural paradise just an hour outside of Seoul, North Korea sits mere miles away, visible from cartoonist Keum Suk Gendry-Kim’s home and studio. It looms over her while she walks her dogs through the rice paddies. Artillery fire, helicopters, and sirens from a nearby military base paint her acoustic landscape. Gendry-Kim has written extensively about the pain and heartbreak experienced throughout Korea’s recent history in her award-winning books Grass and The Waiting. In My friend Kim Jong-Un, Gendry-Kim looks not to the past, but to the present—to the man currently responsible for upholding the national divide.

Retracing his rise to power and uncovering his human side, Gendry-Kim explores the life of the supreme leader of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea: from his birth to his international education, his tastes and hobbies, and his relationships. Gendry-Kim weaves her personal accounts from this process throughout the book, in her signature approach to personal nonfiction by including interviews with former South Korean president Moon Jae-in, North Korean defectors, researchers, journalists, Kim’s former chef, and a friend from his boarding school days in Switzerland.

My Friend Kim Jong-Un carries a message of peace and attempts to make sense of an awful chapter in Korean history. Translated by the award-winning Janet Hong, My Friend… is a cautionary tale and education on what makes a dictator, at a time when these lessons are more relevant in the West than ever.

(Source: Drawn & Quarterly)

185991.description:
Hyeonseok Choi finally becomes the undisputed heavyweight MMA champion of the world, but gets hit by a truck, and dies. A fairy, Rahel, appears and convinces him to fight as a hero in the afterlife, but accidentally sends him to the side of the demons. Stuck in the demon world, he sweet talks his way into positions of power, but slowly discovers this battle between good and evil isn't as clearcut as it seems.

185994.description:
Kuro Heartfield is a minor lord of the frontier territory, but his true identity is that of an ordinary 25-year-old man who was reincarnated into the world of an otome game. He has been exiled to this remote region due to the resentment of some high-ranking nobles, but he found his new life to his liking, and so he has no complaints. Until one day, when he receives a marriage proposal that he could not refuse. His soon-to-be bride's name is Lady Violet Valentine. She is suppose to be a respectable noble lady, the daughter of a duke, but her true identity is that of the so-called villainess, the heroine's antagonist in nearly all routes of this otome game.

This is the start of a slightly mysterious married life between fellow outcasts, both hoping to find a place where they belong!

(Source: Pixiv Comic, translated)
